ou-neg.instruction: Use - on a nonempty object array containing ciphertext Expr cells. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.

ou-zero.instruction: Use unary minus on a rank-zero object array holding a ciphertext; consume its scalar Expr result. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.

ou-view.instruction: Assign a negated object-array view to a new local name, with the unary operand itself a local variable. Use the original/view after the operation so that replacing fresh negation with an in-place negation and aliased result changes the returned model. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.

ou-positive.instruction: Assign +public_object_array to a new local name using a local variable operand. Mutate the source later and use the copied result so that returning an alias instead changes model output. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.

ou-negative-call.instruction: Use np.negative on an explicit object array containing cipher Expr cells. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.

ou-positive-call.instruction: Use np.positive on a public numeric object array; its result must affect the output. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.

ou-plain.instruction: Use unary minus on an object array holding a constructed Plain (for example from Empty plus a public number), retaining symbolic Plain typing; use the result as a ciphertext operand. Original public constant arrays are numeric data, not constructed Plain cells. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.

ou-mixed.instruction: Apply unary minus to one object array containing ciphertext, public real and boolean cells; use the resulting values in output construction. All required operations must execute and affect returned output; no dead or unused padding. Keep the supplied model, constants, packing and security unchanged.
